data.description: Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen – Where Luxury Meets Nature in Dubai’s family-friendly Community

data.answer:
Zinnia is one of the top sub-communities in AKOYA Oxygen. It offers a peaceful environment with green landscapes and eco-friendly homes. The area focuses on sustainability, offering residents a balance between nature and modern living. The family-friendly neighborhood includes parks, cycling tracks, and plenty of open spaces, making it ideal for outdoor enthusiasts. 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen features contemporary villas and townhouses, most equipped with modern amenities and smart-home technologies. Families living in Zinnia enjoy top-notch facilities, including sports courts, playgrounds, and fitness centers, all within walking distance. The community offers a peaceful and secure environment for those seeking luxury and tranquility in Dubai.

Zinnia Dubai properties for sale offer a range of luxurious villas and townhouses, with floor plans ranging from 1,700 to 2,500 sq. ft. These homes come in 3 to 6-bedroom configurations, perfect for families. Each villa features private gardens, spacious living areas, dining halls, and modern kitchens. 

Some layouts even include maid accommodations on the ground floor. All bedrooms are ensuite, with access to private terraces, while larger villas include a guest bedroom on the ground level. Additional features such as double-glazed windows, balconies, and dedicated storage rooms enhance the comfort of living in Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen. 
As part of the Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen family-friendly community, these homes blend luxury living with eco-friendly design. Whether you’re looking to invest or find your dream home, Zinnia Dubai properties for sale provide an ideal balance of modern amenities and tranquil living.

Each building is designed to provide a high standard of living, with spacious layouts and top-quality finishes. Many homes are part of gated communities, ensuring privacy and security. 

Villas here are typically two to three stories, with private gardens and swimming pools. They are known for their energy-efficient designs and premium interiors, which appeal to luxury home seekers in Dubai. Whether you want to rent or buy, these homes offer an upscale lifestyle in a peaceful setting. Zinnia’s famous buildings are known for their family-friendly features and proximity to community amenities.

Renting a Property in Zinnia 

Renting a property in Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is an excellent option for families and professionals seeking luxury and tranquility. Rental trends show that 3-bedroom villas are available for an average price of AED 104,000 annually. Larger villas, such as 4-bedroom units, typically rent around AED 150,000 annually. 

With modern designs and family-friendly amenities like parks and fitness centers, Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen provides an exceptional lifestyle experience. Investors can also benefit from stable rental yields, making the community an attractive choice for those seeking both rental income and a luxurious living environment.

Buying a Property in Zinnia 

Looking for properties for sale in Dubai? Buying a property in Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen presents a valuable investment opportunity in Dubai’s flourishing real estate market. The average sales price for a 3-bedroom villa is AED 1.57M, with prices ranging based on size and location. These modern villas have high-end finishes, smart home technology, and large outdoor spaces, ensuring a luxurious lifestyle. 

Whether you're looking for a family home or an investment, Zinnia Dubai properties for sale promise high rental yields and long-term value appreciation. Zinnia’s ecofriendly design, premium amenities, and strategic location make it an attractive choice for homebuyers and investors.

Life in Zinnia is tranquil and family-friendly. It emphasizes outdoor activities and luxury living. The community is designed for families, offering parks, playgrounds, and sports courts. The lush, green environment promotes a healthy and active lifestyle. 

Zinnia’s eco-friendly features and modern amenities cater to those seeking comfort and sustainability. Residents enjoy easy access to schools, shopping centers, and healthcare facilities. With its peaceful ambiance and contemporary homes, living in Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is ideal for those looking for a serene yet connected community in Dubai.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Zinnia 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen offers ample parking, with each villa providing space for two or more cars. Public transportation within the community is limited, but significant roads and nearby transport hubs make commuting easy:

  • The community is connected by Jebel Ali Lehbab Road (E77) to the south and Dubai Al Ain Road (E66) to the northeast.
  • Bus stops near Zinnia include Rawdah Poultry Farm 1, 18 minutes away by car, and Rawdah Poultry Farm 2, 22 minutes away.
  • The nearest metro stations are Dubai Internet City, Noor Bank, and Business Bay, all about 40 minutes away.
  • Ride-hailing services and taxis are available for residents who need transport to nearby bus stops and metro stations.

Supermarkets in Zinnia 

Residents of Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen have access to several supermarkets, making daily grocery shopping convenient. The closest supermarket is Carrefour in the Akoya Retail Centre, just a 3-minute drive or a 15-minute walk away. Other nearby options include:

  • New Mart Supermarket: 17 minutes by car, offering various foodstuffs and FMCG.
  • Spinneys: Located 26 minutes away by car, perfect for more extensive shopping trips.
  • All Day Minimart: A 28minute drive, providing quick essentials.
  • Carrefour Market: Approximately 29 minutes away for more extensive grocery needs.

These options ensure residents have access to fresh produce and household supplies.

Residents of Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen have access to various shopping malls nearby, providing ample retail and entertainment options. While Zinnia does not have a shopping mall, the closest option is Dubai Outlet Mall, just 30 minutes away, where shoppers can find branded retailers at discounted prices. Other nearby options include:

  • Village Community Mall: Also 30 minutes away, offering a range of stores for daily shopping

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is well-connected to several reputable schools and nurseries in nearby communities, making it an ideal choice for families. Within the community, Shining Stars Nursery Dubai serves preschoolers. Nearby nursery options include:

  • Toddlers International Nursery
  • Fantasy Town Nursery & Play Lounge

For primary and secondary education, residents can access:

  • Delhi Primary School: A 28-minute drive.
  • The Aquilrivate School: Just 9 minutes away, offering education based on the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE).
  • Ranches Pa School: Located 32 minutes away, offering British curriculum education.

These institutions ensure high-quality education options are easily accessible for Zinnia families.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Zinnia Location 

Zinnia, located in the serene community of DAMAC Hills 2, provides easy access to a variety of places of worship, ensuring residents of all faiths feel at home. Here’s a guide to the nearest churches, temples, and mosques with their approximate driving distances.

Mosques

  • Al Madinah Al Mustadama Mosque – Located within DAMAC Hills 2, this mosque offers daily prayers and serves as a key religious center for the community, just 5 minutes’ drive from Zinnia.
  • Al Salam Mosque – Situated in Mudon Community, this beautiful mosque is approximately 20 minutes away, known for its architecture and community programs.

Churches

  • St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church – Located in Jebel Ali Village, this church is a popular destination for the Christian community, offering masses in multiple languages. It is about a 35-minute drive from Zinnia.
  • Christ Church Jebel Ali – Also in Jebel Ali, this Anglican church offers worship services and community events, approximately 35 minutes away by car.

Temples

  • Hindu Temple Dubai – Situated in Bur Dubai, this temple serves as a center for Hindu worship and festivals. It is about a 50-minute drive from Zinnia.
  • Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Gurudwara – Located in Jebel Ali, this magnificent Sikh temple is a welcoming space for all, approximately 35 minutes from Zinnia.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Zinnia Area 

Residents of Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen have access to a range of nearby healthcare facilities and clinics:

Zinnia, located within the AKOYA Oxygen community in Dubailand, offers excellent connectivity to key areas in Dubai. The community is well-connected through major highways like Al Qudra Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. Popular nearby residential areas include Arabian Ranches 2 and Mudon.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Zinnia Area

data.answer:
Living in Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen offers residents a wide array of leisure activities. The community is designed to encourage an active lifestyle with various outdoor activities. Residents can enjoy walking, jogging, or cycling through beautifully landscaped paths. The Trump International Golf Club is nearby, offering a world-class golfing experience. 

The community has swimming pools, wellness centers, and spas for relaxation. Numerous parks and picnic areas are perfect for family outings. With its range of activities, Zinnia offers something for everyone, making it a vibrant and engaging community for residents.

Zinnia Dubai Restaurants 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen residents can access various dining options within the community and nearby areas. The Akoya Community Centre offers several casual dining restaurants, such as Shawarma Location, Nay Oxygen Cafe & Restaurant, Dough Me Nation, and Qasr Al Madina Restaurant & Cafe. For a semiformal dining experience, Nay Oxygen Cafe & Restaurant serves contemporary Western-style dishes like wraps, burgers, and sandwiches. Nearby options include:

  • Al Tawon Restaurant: Serving Indian and Pakistani cuisine.
  • Chuck E Cheese’s: 29 minutes away, offering pizza for families and kids.
  • Dubai Outlet Mall Restaurants: Options include Al Arrab Restaurant, Chowking, and Little Manila for Filipino cuisine.

These dining spots provide Zinnia residents with various options, from casual to semiform meals.

Beaches Near Zinnia 

While Zinnia is inland, several of Dubai’s famous beaches are within a reasonable driving distance. The closest beach, JBR Beach, is about a 35minute from the community. It offers a range of watersports, beachfront dining, and family-friendly attractions. Another popular option is Kite Beach, known for its vibrant atmosphere and water activities and is about 40 minutes away. For a quieter beach experience, residents can visit Al Sufouh Beach, around 35 minutes from Zinnia. These accessible beaches provide a perfect escape for residents looking to relax by the sea on weekends.

Hotels in Zinnia Area 

Although Zinnia doesn't have hotels within the community, several luxury hotels are nearby. The Trump International Golf Club Dubai is the closest high-end accommodation, offering luxurious suites and fine dining. About 25 minutes away, you’ll find Arabian Ranches Golf Club Hotel, a perfect getaway for those seeking comfort and leisure. 

For a more expansive experience, the world-famous Burj Al Arab is within a 40-minute drive from Zinnia. These nearby hotels offer residents' guests convenient options for staying close while enjoying world-class hospitality. The proximity to premium hotels ensures visitors can experience the best Dubai offers.

Community Events 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is a vibrant community that hosts regular events for its residents. These events foster a strong sense of community and provide opportunities for families to connect. The community offers various social and recreational activities, from seasonal festivals to weekly markets. 

Outdoor movie nights, food truck festivals, and sports tournaments are just a few examples of the events held within the community. These gatherings are perfect for families and individuals looking to enjoy a lively, social environment. Zinnia’s active event calendar helps make the community an engaging and inclusive living place.

Zinnia Attractions and Landmarks 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is located near several prominent landmarks and attractions in Dubai, offering residents plenty of entertainment and cultural experiences. Notable nearby attractions include:

  • Dubai Miracle Garden: It is a 37-minute drive away and features stunning flower displays and lifesized structures adorned with vibrant flora.
  • Dubai Autodrome: 38 minutes away, where visitors can experience the thrill of driving high-performance race cars on a professional racetrack.
  • Al Marmoom Heritage Village: Located 21 minutes away, it offers camel races, traditional souks, and cultural festivals during March and April.

These landmarks provide excellent leisure opportunities for Zinnia residents, combining nature, culture, and adventure.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons 

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen offers residents a variety of outdoor activities, fitness options, and beauty services. Nearby parks such as Central Park (23 minutes away), Eastland Park (30 minutes), and Al Rashidiya Park (32 minutes) provide recreational spaces with playgrounds and grassy areas for sports. 

For fitness enthusiasts, Fitness Edge and CK Fitness Gym are both just 5 minutes away and offer state-of-the-art equipment.

Beauty services are also nearby:

  • Le Vendôme Ladies Beauty Lounge and The Corner Barber (5 minutes away)
  • The Haven Spa and Beauty Salon (24 minutes)
  • NStyle Beauty Lounge for comprehensive hair, nail, and skincare treatments

Zinnia AKOYA Oxygen is an ideal community for families and professionals seeking luxury living in a peaceful setting. However, it is farther from central Dubai, and residents will require a car for commutes.
